# Experience

```{r}
#| label: experience
experience <-
  here::here("data/experience.yaml") |>
  read_yaml() |>
  mutate(why = sub("\n$", "", why)) |>
  head(if (BUILD == "resume") 4 else Inf) |>
  separate_longer_delim(why, "\n") |> 
  md_to_latex()

switch(
  BUILD,
  cv = {
    experience |>
      vitae::detailed_entries(
        what = what,
        when = where,
        with = with,
        where = when,
        why = why,
        .protect = FALSE
      )
  },
  resume = {
    experience |>
      # filter(row_number() <= 5, .by = what) |>
      vitae::detailed_entries(
        what = what,
        when = where,
        with = with,
        where = when,
        why = why,
        # .protect = FALSE
      )
  }
)
```
